snippet.title: Airborne Empire 1.0 | Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Airborne Empire is a flying city builder that uniquely blends role-playing, city-building, and open-world exploration from high in the clouds. Players manage scarce resources and travel through distant lands, all while constructing their flying city to become both a fortress and a home to many.

Get it now on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2438680/Airborne_Empire/
